scope: Seven current Schedule record kinds, typed creation/editing and authoritative local display

paired.method: Actual fixed Schedule domain/update functions versus Native; exact values, error names/codes/messages and retained/replaced record identity.

verification.source: 118 original update.spec.ts and rrule.spec.ts tests passed; broader service cases remain Source-only evidence.
verification.native: 9 passed: new seven-rule/edit/display journeys and interval/wall/Cron direct consumers.

behavior: Completes current RRULE record creation/decoding/updates and dispatch through the shared bounded time engine. All seven authoritative record kinds now have a common decoder and recurring dispatch entry.

Typed timing requires exactly one matching selector. Equivalent normalized timing retains a committed target; descriptive edits retain nested weekday identity, changed rules re-arm, and expired one-shot resumption requires a new future schedule.
Record reads produce detached immutable values without recomputing a target. Display uses the authoritative zone, extended local years and Temporal's nearest-minute offset presentation.
diagnostics: The initial pair exposed that Temporal preserves historic local seconds while rounding the printed offset to the nearest minute. Native now matches both positive historic offsets and the negative half-minute case; original failed values remain retained.

cleanup.retained: Commands, input hashes, paired values/identity/errors, Source results and Native logs/XML/observations; owned synthetic short workspaces and homes removed.

limitations: Host task persistence/schema evolution, management/runtime and current tools remain pending. Production Schedule bindings remain historical.
No complete regression, application/session, Portable/browser/Win7 acceptance or upstream promotion.
